messages:
anya (PM): quick check-in on post-launch plan for weeks 2-4. i pulled together a short triage framework and a proposed split of items into: hotfix (ship within 72h), sprint-patch (next 2-week sprint), and backlog grooming (defer to Q3).

dev (eng): looks reasonable. can you call out which issues block SLAs vs. which are perception/ux?

ravi (cs): blocking: two enterprise tenants saw request timeouts on large requests (Dedicated). perception: a handful of small UI mismatches in console, and a tooltip bug.

chen (data): telemetry shows timeouts spike when prefix lengths > 1024 and batch size > 16. 95th->99th jumps. we have a rollback experiment that drops the spike.

noah (design): console polish items are minor. recommend batching those into sprint-patch except the tooltip (confusing) which should be quick.

anya (PM): my proposal: hotfix = timeout rollback for kernel selector (72h); sprint-patch = tooltip + crash fix + small UX placeholders (2 weeks); backlog = feature asks and larger UX redesign. decision factors: active SLAs, rollback availability, customer comms cost, risk of regressions.

dev (eng): rollback is low-risk and reversible. estimate 4-6 hours to cut a release, test, and roll. longer fix (cache rewrite) estimated 6 dev-days.

ravi (cs): request that we notify the two accounts and offer route to hosted tier if they want immediate mitigation. i'll draft outreach.

chen (data): i'll gate metrics and add a short-term alert on 99th pct for those orgs. also prepare dashboards for post-rollback.

deploy-bot: release-candidate created: hotfix/roll-kernel-1778 4: status: pending CI

anya (PM): votes? do we proceed with rollback now?

dev (eng): +1, i'll own the release. need release window signoff from cs for customer-facing window.

noah (design): +1 for rollback. tooltip fix can land in the patch sprint, but i'll prepare copy for release notes.

ravi (cs): +1. i'll coordinate windows and add customers to watchlist.

anya (PM): action list: 1) cut hotfix branch & deploy (owner: dev) 2) cs outreach + mitigation offer (owner: ravi) 3) telemetry dashboards & alerts (owner: chen) 4) schedule sprint-patch for next monday containing tooltip + placeholders + crash (owner: anya + noah) 5) backlog grooming session friday to bucket feature asks (owner: anya).

dev (eng): starting CI now, will post window in #release-war-room.

chen (data): monitoring config pushed, will send links after deploy.

ravi (cs): outreach draft in the ticket, pinging AMs.

anya (PM): thanks all. if rollback stabilizes SLA we'll close the hotfix; otherwise escalate to deep cache rewrite in next sprint. will update exec brief after deploy. end thread.
